subject: NetworkPkg/Ip4Dxe: Reject IPv4 addresses ending with dot
reasons: Single-site refactoring of one function (Ip4Config2StrToIp) in one file — replacing a custom hand-rolled IPv4 parser with a call to StrToIpv4Address()
One-off API migration specific to this function; the change deletes ~40 lines of custom parsing code and replaces with a helper, but this pattern does not appear elsewhere
The fix requires case-by-case reasoning about the EndPointer validation and the specific invalid-trailing-dot bug
